newsitem.title: USA: U.S. MTBE WEAKENS IN A LULL OF ACTIVITY.
newsitem.headline: U.S. MTBE WEAKENS IN A LULL OF ACTIVITY.

text.p: U.S. spot MTBE prices were weaker on Wednesday amid a lull in activity and a tapering off of demand, players said.
In the U.S. Gulf, prompt MTBE barrels were pegged between 93.00 cents and 94.00 cents a gallon, about 1.50 cents below last week.
A New York Harbor parcel was sold this morning for 98.00 cents, about four cents off highs reached last week when there was greater refiner demand.
Players said much of the market was focused on a major MTBE player who traders said needs to move 100,000 barrels of the gasoline additive to the Harbor by August 25.
One trader said the player was seen trying to sell down the Gulf, indicating he may gather his barrels from Houston.
-- Laney Salisbury, New York Energy Desk +1 212 859 1631--
